BUT: relocating now realizes the $1,372 ST gain. Recommendation: keep current lot in taxable (hold to LT) · open NEW ROST position in IRA for any future adds. Tax-aware allocation: long-term holds in taxable (LTCG rate), active trades in retirement accounts.

📌 Held-position playbook: (1) Hold all 85 shares to LT (2027-04-05 / 05-01). (2) Do NOT add new lots today — sector cap, risk budget, and tax-timing all argue against. (3) If ROST trades below $197 AND you trim TJX by 1%, add 1% ROST (pair-rotation, not new exposure). (4) Hedge available: long-ROST / short-XRT pair to neutralize beta if swing weakness intensifies. (5) Re-assess at TJX earnings (2026-06-08) and ROST ER (2026-06-26).
✗ INVALIDATES THIS CALL: (a) Quality breaks (F<5 OR Z<1.8 OR ROIC<WACC) = EXIT FULL regardless of tax impact (the loss avoided outweighs the tax cost). (b) Sector cap policy changes (e.g., promoted to 25% from 20%) = ADD opportunity opens. (c) Tax bracket changes (job loss · early retirement) = ST gain treatment may flip to favorable bracket. (d) NAV grows substantially (> $750K) = 3.6% becomes < 2.5%, less critical to sector cap.
